messages:
marie (eng-platform): Quick heads-up — proposal to introduce a small header rename + metadata split: we want to add `x-rd-route-v2` (structured JSON) and a separate `x-cost-center` for quota attribution. This is to decouple routing affinity from billing/console attribution.

sam (sdk): Do we have a schema for `x-rd-route-v2`? JSON vs single token? how big can it get?

marie (eng-platform): Plan is structured JSON (short): {"route": "svc-A/fast", "priority": "low-latency"}. It stays tiny. `x-cost-center` is a simple slug.

ben (devex): From SDK perspective we should avoid breaking users. Can we auto-read legacy `x-route` and translate to v2 server-side for a transition window?

hank (eng): We can server-side translate but console telemetry currently keys dashboards on header name. If we rename client-side, we'll lose continuity for metric backfills unless we map both keys in the pipeline.

aria (console): Exactly — console queries expect a single canonical field in traces/metrics. If we double-write for a while that's OK but we need a plan for tag migration so historical tiles remain sensible.

julia (product): Timeline ask: customers need 90-day migration minimum. Also product wants a feature flag to opt new clients into `x-rd-route-v2` earlier for canaries.

sam (sdk): Proposed SDK approach: inject both headers client-side for 120 days (legacy `x-route` + new `x-rd-route-v2`) when a feature-flag is set. Then after server-side mapping and console migration, flip to only `x-rd-route-v2`. Provide a transparent opt-in flag and env var. Example Python shim:```python
# in redwood/sdk/transport.py
route_hint = {"route": "svc-A/fast", "priority": "low-latency"}
headers = {"x-rd-route-v2": json.dumps(route_hint)}
if os.getenv("REDWOOD_ROUTE_SHIM", "on") == "on":
    headers["x-route"] = f"svc-A/fast"  # legacy form for servers still looking for it
```

sam (sdk): Go snippet for token users:```go
routeHint := map[string]string{"route":"svc-A/fast","priority":"low-latency"}
body, _ := json.Marshal(routeHint)
req.Header.Set("x-rd-route-v2", string(body))
if os.Getenv("REDWOOD_ROUTE_SHIM") != "off" {
    req.Header.Set("x-route", "svc-A/fast")
}
```

ben (devex): Good. We'll need tests for both header present/absent and for SDKs that set only legacy or only v2. Also update client changelogs with clear migration steps.

hank (eng): Operationally: pipeline change to normalize both `x-route` and `x-rd-route-v2` into a canonical field in our metrics plumbing. We should tag telemetry with a `route_version` attribute so we can monitor skew during rollout.

aria (console): We'll add `route_version` to the dashboard breakdown and a small migration script to remap historical tiles by heuristics (if route string matches existing known routes, map to canonical). But we need sample data to validate remap heuristics.

marie (eng-platform): Action items: (1) eng to implement telemetry normalization + `route_version` in metrics (owner: hank) (2) sdk to include shim flag and tests (owner: sam) (3) console to add tile opt-in to show v1+v2 side-by-side (owner: aria) (4) product to publish 120-day migration notice and canary opt-in details (owner: julia).

julia (product): I suggest we default the SDK shim to ON for new releases and document how to opt-out. We'll publish a deprecation banner in Console two weeks before turning the shim off for managed pods.

sam (sdk): Question: telemetry sampling — some customers already sample route tags aggressively. If we add `route_version`, will that double-count in the console usage graphs?

aria (console): No double-counting if pipeline dedups on request-id. But we'll add a noise filter for high-cardinality tests. Also we should expose a per-tenant sampling knob to avoid exploding metrics for very noisy tenants.

hank (eng): CI wise: adding `x-rd-route-v2` header changes signature surfaces (minor). CI-bot: please run the metrics ingest test matrix against both single-header and dual-header payloads.

ci-bot: Running matrix jobs: unit-tests, e2e-metrics-ingest, sdk-smoke (py/go/ts). Job queued...

ben (devex): UX note for SDK release notes: include a small migration snippet and a link to Console's mapping preview feature. Keep the changelog title non-alarming — "route metadata: opt-in header v2 + shim".

marie (eng-platform): Final check — are we agreed on 120-day shim window and feature-flagged canary?

sam (sdk): yes (we'll default ON in next minor).

hank (eng): yes — will start pipeline changes this week.

aria (console): yes — will add mapping preview and `route_version` graphs to the console beta.

julia (product): I'll draft the migration email and update the docs.

marie (eng-platform): OK locking this in. Thanks all. :tada:
